items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: It was my lullaby when Moes Jr. was a baby.

ctx.x: See we're recording today in Tippo, Mississippi at the home of Mr. and Mrs. Moe's Allison Sr. and today's date is May the 24th, 1960. So let's get your name on here first.

Yes your name go ahead. Maxine Allison. I see and you used to sing this song we wanted? It was my lullaby when Moes Jr. was a baby. It was handed down from my husband's father who used to sing it to him as a little boy. Now you'd be drawing now. Well I was drawing already.
I'm sure they were on here too. Oh my name is Moe Allison Sr. And I put mine on here, Dick Allen, and our engineer is Bill Claxton over there. He's being sung.
